subject.title: feat: let plugins control inbound debounce policy

question: Should OpenClaw publish a generic `inbound_debounce` plugin-SDK hook for a currently WhatsApp-only need, or instead pursue the narrower WhatsApp conversation-config direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100970?
rationale: Both open proposals address the same per-conversation batching need but establish different long-lived public contracts; repository policy places owner-specific behavior in the owning plugin unless a shared seam is justified.

options.title: Favor WhatsApp-owned configuration
options.body: Sponsor the narrower WhatsApp configuration path and do not add a generic plugin-SDK hook until another channel or plugin proves the shared API is needed.

options.title: Sponsor the generic hook
options.body: Approve this SDK contract only with a documented multi-plugin rationale, compatibility commitment, and real WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Defer both surfaces
options.body: Keep both proposals open but unmerged until a maintainer defines the intended debounce product direction.

recommendation.title: Favor WhatsApp-owned configuration
recommendation.body: Sponsor the narrower WhatsApp configuration path and do not add a generic plugin-SDK hook until another channel or plugin proves the shared API is needed.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr is the only repository member in the supplied discussion who explicitly took ownership of reviewing this contract choice.
